title: re:Post, Knowledge Center and Prescriptive Guidance

kcs.statement: AWS re:Post is AWS's free community Q&A site where AWS experts and users answer technical questions; it replaced the AWS Forums.
The AWS Knowledge Center, part of re:Post, holds AWS-written articles answering the most frequent customer questions and is open to every Support plan.

AWS Prescriptive Guidance offers time-tested strategies, guides and patterns from AWS and partners for migration and modernization, while AWS whitepapers and documentation explain service details and architectural best practice.

problem_ideas: A Basic Support user has a how-to question about S3 permissions: name two free places to find an answer.
A team wants a step-by-step pattern for migrating Oracle to Aurora: which resource?
Which resource answers 'Why can't I connect to my EC2 instance?' with an AWS-written article?
A student needs the official explanation of the Well-Architected pillars: where is it published?
Map each to its source: community answer, AWS-written FAQ article, migration playbook, service API reference.
Spot the false statement: 're:Post requires a paid Support plan.'
